question: How the dataset was collected?
keywords: collected collection gathering scraping crawling sources method methodology acquisition obtained compiled
summary: Describes how the dataset was collected.
description:
A free-form text that describes how a dataset was collected.

Examples include the sources from which a dataset was scrapped and
the interview protocol that was used for data collection.

retrieval.hypothetical_passage: We collected the dataset by manually authoring and curating items. Graduate and undergraduate students wrote and reviewed each question, drawing from publicly available examination materials, practice tests, textbooks, online resources, and competitive-programming platforms. We create a massive multitask test consisting of multiple-choice questions across many subjects, sourcing items from freely available sources. The collection process involved hand-writing problems, crowdsourced annotation, inter-annotator review, and validation rounds. We collected a specific number of questions in total through this process. The annotators verified accuracy and removed duplicates.

extraction.instruction: Extract how the dataset was collected, including data sources, collection methods, time period, and any annotation or interview protocols.
extraction.field_spec: SPDX property `dataset_dataCollectionProcess`. Free-form text (xsd:string), single value. Should read as a brief narrative covering source(s), method (scraping / crowdsourcing / interviews / API), and timeframe when stated.
extraction.output_guidance: Quote source URLs, dataset names, and crowdsourcing platforms verbatim. If the source covers multiple stages (raw collection vs. annotation), capture both. If only the upstream dataset is cited without describing how it was collected, note that the process is inherited from the upstream source and name it. Return noAssertion if the card omits collection details entirely.
